body:
# C-08B: fixed displaced T1 increment, seeds13..16

2 October 2026. Fourth authorised batch complete and stopped:16 fresh candidates,32 planner invocations,10 new complete certificates and six retained unknown candidates. Offline version2 bank now has47 distinct accepted entries plus separate fallback. All diversity/fallback gates pass; the missing17 entries keep `complete:false`.

## Changed files and preservation

Exact claims preceded edits in `codex-C-08B.md`. Changed owned driver `scripts/dev/assemble-displaced-t1-bank.mjs`, tests `scripts/dev/test-displaced-t1-bank.mjs`, derived `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/displaced-v1/bank-manifest.json`, this report and parent report. New immutable directories: `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/displaced-v1/bank-candidates/tier-1-{river,islands,hedges,terraces}-seed-{13,14,15,16}/`.

The driver accepts explicitly selected batch `13-16` alongside the three earlier authorised batches. Exact membership, immutable request/result identity and unchanged two8000-state caps apply. Unsupported ranges fail before work. No automatic next range, cap escalation or retry of any earlier success/unknown/checkpoint. Other completed batches are read and independently replayed into cumulative coverage.

All396 previous evidence files, covering seed0 and seeds1..12, retain matching before/after SHA256 `3875b57a984074e74dc8bac0c62ebfc4f5a61afa10981653d795a250d62e4126`, computed from sorted relative filenames and exact bytes. Existing dirty changes were preserved. Runtime/default version1, Claude source, App/private gate/rewards and shared build outputs were not edited. No artwork or live UI change in this offline increment.

## Executable checks and outcomes

```text
node scripts/dev/assemble-displaced-t1-bank.mjs --batch 13-16
node --test --test-reporter=spec scripts/dev/test-displaced-t1-bank.mjs expeditions/v2/generation/displaced-four-locks.test.js expeditions/v2/generation/runtime-generation.test.js scripts/dev/test-orchard-v2-certification.mjs
node scripts/dev/assemble-displaced-t1-bank.mjs --batch 13-16
```

All33 targeted checks pass. New tests enforce fourth-batch seed bounds and identity, independently replay all16 new packets, reconstruct the ten accepted packets, verify32 requests/25 winning traces and exact cumulative manifest membership/gaps. Existing production reducer/preview hashes, real printed-card stat/commissioning assignments, target strength bands, distinct teams/output plans, winning-phase physical alcove proof, tampering, canonical dedup, fallback exclusion and interruption/no-retry tests remain passing.

Initial invocation processed16/skipped0, exactly two8000-state requests per candidate.25 new winning traces contain709 accepted commands. Each new directory's `traces.json` is executable real production-reducer evidence and `result.json` holds both requests/counters/certification. Disk resume processed0/skipped16, zero new generation/planner calls; only derived manifest was refreshed. No screenshots: this work certifies offline reducer traces, not live UI acceptance.

River seed13, hedges seeds14/15 and terraces seed14 retain direct wins but lack actual alcove proof. River seed14 retains neither. Unknown is bounded lack of proof, not impossibility; no retries were made.

Known Claude-owned R-07 remains explicit: seven exhausted requests report denied-spend overages20,34,15,18,43,18,13, total161. All request caps remain8000; these counters do not establish actual admitted reducer work beyond the cap. No planner, enemy, threshold or cost weakening.
